Course Highlights

    Course Overview

    Everything you need to know about this course

    This introductory course is designed to help young learners build a foundational understanding of numbers through playful activities. Children will explore basic counting, number recognition, shapes, and patterns using colorful toys, rhymes, and interactive games. The aim is to foster early numeracy skills in a stress-free and joyful environment, laying the groundwork for future mathematical learning.
